items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 25:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Gevurot of the crown of Gevura? There are two aspects of Gevurot: male Gevurot and female Gevurot. For those drawn from the Mazal, where the Gevura of the Yesod of Malchut serves, namely Benjamin included in Joseph, are called male Gevurot. And it is the aspect of the Gevurot of the crown of Gevura within the Mochin of ZA. However, those drawn from the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in the Mochin of the Mazal, are called female Gevurot. And it is the aspect of the Gevura within the Mochin of the Nukva of ZA. And see above, in Answers 7 and 8. (Item 118).
